scripts.dev: npm run dev:next & npm run dev:hono
scripts.gen:api-types: npm run gen:types --workspace hono && npm run format
scripts.check-types: npm run check-types --workspace hono && npm run check-types --workspace next && npm run check-types --workspace sanity
scripts.clean: rm -rf next/node_modules hono/node_modules sanity/node_modules node_modules next/.next sanity/.sanity sanity/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo hono/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
